what_is_measured: official time over 40 yards from a stationary start
physical_meaning: average speed over the whole run in one number
reliability: single official value: measurement error not estimable from this data
what_cannot_be_concluded: how the time was built: two different speed curves can give the same time

what_is_measured: official time over the first 10 yards
physical_meaning: early acceleration as timed by the stopwatch
reliability: single official value: measurement error not estimable from this data
what_cannot_be_concluded: the shape of the acceleration inside those 10 yards

what_is_measured: mean acceleration while tracked speed rises from 2 to 4 yd/s
physical_meaning: how hard speed is built in the first steps
difference_from_official_testing: inside the 10-yard split, which mixes this band with reaction and the next bands
reliability: unstable — repeat-attempt ICC 0.35 (372 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.08 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: movements that start from rest or near rest: the first steps after the snap and short-area starts (physical relation only)
what_to_look_at_next: film of first steps; a timed start with split timing
what_cannot_be_concluded: whether it is used, or matters, in a game; the band spans very few 10 Hz frames

what_is_measured: mean acceleration while tracked speed rises from 4 to 6 yd/s
physical_meaning: how hard speed is built in the middle of the acceleration
difference_from_official_testing: not isolated by any official split
reliability: unstable — repeat-attempt ICC 0.49 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.29 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: building speed while already moving: movements that develop over several yards after the first steps (physical relation only)
what_to_look_at_next: film of movements that develop over several yards; a rolling-start test
what_cannot_be_concluded: performance from a rolling start: the forty passes this band once, from rest

what_is_measured: mean acceleration while tracked speed rises from 6 to 8 yd/s
physical_meaning: how hard speed is still built late in the acceleration
difference_from_official_testing: not isolated by any official split
reliability: moderately_repeatable_partly_beyond_stopwatch — repeat-attempt ICC 0.61 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.47 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: reaching and holding high speed over distance: long pursuits and movements down the field (physical relation only)
what_to_look_at_next: film of long movements; a longer sprint

what_is_measured: time for tracked speed to rise from 4 to 8 yd/s
physical_meaning: how quickly speed builds through the middle of the run
difference_from_official_testing: partly explained by the official times; repeatable after they are accounted for (Milestone 08B.4)
reliability: repeatable_beyond_official — repeat-attempt ICC 0.82 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.65 (08B.4 scouting evidence registry (residual repeatability, cross-fitted))
related_football_movements: building speed while already moving: movements that develop over several yards after the first steps (physical relation only)
what_to_look_at_next: compare film of mid-distance movements; a rolling-start test
what_cannot_be_concluded: any NFL outcome: no incremental prediction was established (Milestones 06 and 08B)

what_is_measured: 95th percentile of tracked speed in the forty
physical_meaning: the speed actually reached and held
difference_from_official_testing: largely the same information as the official forty
reliability: repeatable_beyond_official — repeat-attempt ICC 0.95 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.87 (08B.4 scouting evidence registry (residual repeatability, cross-fitted))
what_to_look_at_next: confirms or questions the official time; little new information
what_cannot_be_concluded: the athlete's true maximum: 40 yards may end before it

what_is_measured: tracked speed when 10 yards are covered
physical_meaning: speed already built after the first 10 yards
difference_from_official_testing: the 10-yard split gives the TIME to that point; this gives the SPEED at it
reliability: moderately_repeatable_partly_beyond_stopwatch — repeat-attempt ICC 0.73 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.61 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: movements that start from rest or near rest: the first steps after the snap and short-area starts (physical relation only)
what_cannot_be_concluded: anything about speed later in the run

what_is_measured: tracked speed when 20 yards are covered
physical_meaning: speed at the middle of the run
reliability: repeatable_mostly_stopwatch — repeat-attempt ICC 0.93 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.90 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: building speed while already moving: movements that develop over several yards after the first steps (physical relation only)
what_cannot_be_concluded: whether the speed is reached in pads, in a game

what_is_measured: tracked speed when 30 yards are covered
difference_from_official_testing: close to the official forty for most athletes
reliability: repeatable_mostly_stopwatch — repeat-attempt ICC 0.95 (375 athletes with a repeat); R² on official times 0.90 (09B local screen (raw ICC and in-sample R²; weaker than the 08B.4 method))
related_football_movements: reaching and holding high speed over distance: long pursuits and movements down the field (physical relation only)

what_is_measured: distance between two athletes in the TCN-B representation of the forty sequence
physical_meaning: none: a mathematical pattern of the whole recording
difference_from_official_testing: almost unrelated to the official times, and highly repeatable between attempts
reliability: repeat-attempt retrieval is strong (Milestones 04B and 08B.4); a similarity, not a measurement
what_to_look_at_next: a prompt to look at the two speed curves side by side
what_cannot_be_concluded: an athletic trait: no dimension has a physical meaning, and repeatable is not predictive

what_is_measured: share of observed NFL episodes of a demand (same position) at or below the prospect's measured Combine value
physical_meaning: where a maximal-effort Combine value sits inside the range of game demands
difference_from_official_testing: uses tracked band values the official tests do not isolate
reliability: inherits the repeat-attempt error of the Combine value; shown with an interval or abstains
related_football_movements: the named movement demand, in physical terms (physical relation only)
what_to_look_at_next: film of that demand; a targeted test of that band
what_cannot_be_concluded: that the prospect will meet the demand in a game: descriptive similarity, not a validated ability
